ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation (low-intensity) serving as the substrate for numerous scattered high-contrast white annular rings and solid white circular spots. A localized area of high-texture grey ridges is visible in the lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged boundary with irregular triangular peaks and varied depth valleys across the entire trailing perimeter of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity with a steep rise toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle diagonal linear ridges or striations radiating from the central peduncle attachment point toward the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both left and right lobes; numerous circular healed bite scars across the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive vertical pleating or textural skin folds at the junction of the fluke and the peduncle.
